newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks end with another slide.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks end with another slide.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite fell nearly 16 points to close at 1201 on Wednesday, the second straight session selloff.
With the decline on Wednesday, the index is off 13.5 percent since it hit a record close of 1388 on January 22.
Losers beat winners by a margin of about two to one on volume of more than 590 million shares.

The biggest gainer was CD Radio, which rose 5/32 to 12-19/32, a gain of 70 percent. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission awarded a license to the company to provide a nationwide radio service with CD-quality reception.

Project Software lost half its value, falling 15-15/16 to 15-5/16. The company said second quarter earnings would fall below last year's level due to a shortfall in some product revenues, and weakness in European sales.
PeopleSoft fell 3-3/8 to 36-3/8. Analysts said that while investors were worried about financial results, the fears may prove unfounded.
Gateway 2000 jumped 3-1/4 to 55-5/8. The company said it would begin a major-account sales operation at its Kansas City facility.
